# Askdeb

> > Askdeb is a comprehensive documentation and component library showcasing UI components, design system features, and interactive elements with syntax highlighting and code display capabilities.

Askdeb provides detailed documentation for a modern design system built on WordPress and Gutenberg, featuring reusable UI components, interactive documentation, and developer-friendly tools for building consistent web interfaces.

## Key Topics

- UI Components
- Design System
- Button Styles
- Accordions and Tabs
- Alert Messages
- Syntax Highlighting
- Prism Plugin
- Code Display
- Component Documentation
- Gutenberg
- Feature Documentation
- Icon Buttons
- Galleries
- Interactive Elements
- WordPress

## Core Features

- [Features Overview](https://www.askdeb.com/features): Overview of Askdeb features including syntax highlighting, galleries, and Prism plugin

## UI Components & Documentation

- [Buttons](https://www.askdeb.com/features/buttons): Documentation of button component styles, sizes, colors, and icon variants
- [Accordions and Tabs](https://www.askdeb.com/features/accordions-and-tabs): Guide to accordion and tab UI components and interactive elements
- [Alert Messages](https://www.askdeb.com/features/alert-messages): Documentation of alert message components and notification system

## Optional

- [Block Unit Test](https://www.askdeb.com/block-unit-test): Gutenberg block test page with typography examples and HTML elements
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.askdeb.com/privacy-policy-2): Privacy policy covering data collection, cookies, GDPR compliance, and retention
